name: tanayai
description: Local-first AI copilot: on-device speech-to-text (TanayVoice) + DeepSeek / opencode / commandcode answers in an overlay excluded from screen capture.
author: Tanay Mitra

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: TanayAI listens to the meeting audio so it can transcribe it on-device with TanayVoice.
extendInfo.NSScreenCaptureUsageDescription: TanayAI needs screen access to capture system audio from calls.
